techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.locality: Electronic City (west of Hosur Road), Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The original KEONICS township (founded 1978 by R. K. Baliga; about 800 acres across all phases, roughly 200 IT/ITES campuses, maintained since 1997 by the Electronics City Industrial Township Authority, ELCITA). Phase 1 is the older, mostly west-of-Hosur-Road core holding the Infosys and Wipro headquarters campuses, the Siemens/3M/BHEL/HP strip along Hosur Road, the E-City towers at Veerasandra and the C-DOT, C-DAC and STPI government campuses. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 1 features in OpenStreetMap, not from an official boundary.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 2
aliases: KIADB Industrial Area Phase II Electronic City
techParks.locality: Electronic City (east of Hosur Road) / Doddathogur / Veerasandra, Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The KIADB-developed eastern extension of Electronics City (the 'KIADB Industrial Area, Phase II, Electronic City' of company addresses), reached from Hosur Road via Shantipura Main Road and Infosys Avenue. It holds the TCS Think Campus, Tech Mahindra's plots 45-47, Continental's Technical Center India, Aurigene (plots 39-40), Hical (plots 46-47), the Gold Hill parks and the Veerasandra Industrial Estate with Titan's 'Integrity' office and Tessolve. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 2 features in OpenStreetMap.

techParks.name: Infosys Electronics City Campus
techParks.description: Infosys's global headquarters campus on Hosur Road in Electronics City Phase 1 (business address in SEC filings: 'Electronics City, Hosur Rd, Bangalore'), mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/364872809 with a smaller second Infosys polygon to the south.

techParks.name: Wipro Electronic City Campus
techParks.description: Wipro's multi-tower Electronics City delivery campus (EC1, EC2/3 with its Learning Centre and Executive Briefing Centre, and EC4 across the road), mapped in OpenStreetMap as Towers 1-23 along Wipro Avenue; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names it among the township's main campuses.

techParks.name: TCS Think Campus
techParks.locality: Electronics City Phase 2, Shantipura Main Road
techParks.description: Tata Consultancy Services' Bengaluru flagship campus in Electronics City Phase 2, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/188314420 with its entrance on Shantipura Main Road; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names TCS's main campus among the township's anchors.

techParks.name: Velankani Tech Park
techParks.locality: 43, Electronics City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road
techParks.description: Velankani Group's own IT park at #43 Electronic City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road, housing the group's IT and hospitality businesses including The Oterra hotel (OSM places 'The Oterra Bengaluru Electronics City' inside the polygon).

techParks.name: Biocon Park
techParks.description: Biocon's integrated research and biologics manufacturing campus and SEZ at Bommasandra, south of Electronics City; Wikipedia pictures the Biocon Research Centre inside it and Syngene is headquartered there. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/545039647.

techParks.name: HCL Technologies SEZ Jigani
techParks.description: HCLTech's SEZ delivery campus off the Bommasandra-Jigani Link Road, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/170320607; Wikipedia's Jigani article names HCL among the companies that brought workers to the area.

techParks.name: AMR Tech Park
techParks.description: Multi-building office park (AMR Tech Park I, II, 3A/3B, 4/4A per OSM) at No. 23 & 24 Hongasandra on Hosur Main Road, Bommanahalli, about 7 km north of Electronics City. Tally Solutions' head office, Sagility's Buildings 1 and 2A and Quinnox's AMR Tech Park-4 office are confirmed from company pages; HGS, Mindteck, MetricStream and Avaya are recorded there by OpenStreetMap only.

techParks.name: Ozone Manay Tech Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise IT park on the service road of Hosur Road at Garvebhavipalya, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/1257330725; no tenant could be confirmed from a company page during this run, so the tenant list is left empty.

techParks.name: Gold Hill Excelsior Park
techParks.description: Gold Hill's software park in Electronics City Phase 2 beside TCS Think Campus and Tech Mahindra (North Wing / South Wing buildings in OSM); a Siemens node sits inside it in OpenStreetMap. Gold Hill Supreme Park lies just south on Infosys Avenue.

techParks.name: Veerasandra Industrial Estate
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate on the east side of Hosur Road forming the southern part of Electronics City Phase 2; company addresses here read 'Veerasandra Village, Attibele Hobli, Anekal Taluk'. Holds Titan's 'Integrity' corporate office, Tessolve and Aurigene on Jogger's Lane, Continental and Velankani Electronics Unit-2.

techParks.name: Bommasandra Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB's large manufacturing estate south of Electronics City on Hosur Road (OSM operator KIADB, way/103293015), home to bearing, tooling, pharma and EV plants; Narayana Health's hospital campus is also here but is excluded as a hospital. Biocon Park adjoins it on the Jigani link road.

techParks.name: Jigani Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial estate at Jigani, south-west of Bommasandra (OSM operator KIADB, way/103293010), mixing granite exporters and small engineering units with Otis's No. 92 elevator factory, LAPP India's cable plant, Velankani Electronics Unit-3 and Tata Advanced Systems' 2025 composite-structures facility; HCLTech's SEZ sits on its north-east edge.

coverageNotes: SEARCH LIMIT: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before this lens ran, so verification used direct WebFetch of company contact/location pages, Wikipedia and SEC EDGAR plus the OSM extracts; many corporate sites (Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCLTech, Siemens, HPE, Bosch, Continental, 3M, Biocon, Syngene, Timken, Mindteck, TaeguTec, Lapp, Delta, STPI, Tata Power Solar, Cyient, Flex, DXC) answered 403/503 or had no address text, which is why several large campuses carry 'medium' (OSM polygon + Wikipedia Electronic City tenant list) rather than 'high'. CONFIRMED FROM PRIMARY PAGES: Infosys (EDGAR), Tech Mahindra (plots 45-47), HP Inc (5 offices incl. Tower 1 E-City), Genpact (Surya Park + 3), Titan ('Integrity'), Yokogawa (Plot 96), FANUC (41-A), Tejas, OnMobile, Aurigene (39-40(P)), Hical (46 & 47), Velankani (3 sites), Tally, Sagility (3 sites), Quinnox, BHIVE/AKR, Otis (No. 92 Jigani), C-DOT, Kyndryl, Toshiba Software, Happiest Minds, Reltio, Ultraviolette (Domlur HQ). OSM-ONLY LEADS INCLUDED AT LOW CONFIDENCE: DXC, SEG Automotive, Schneider/APC, Flex, SKF, TaeguTec, Delta, Mindteck, MetricStream, Avaya, Cyient, HGS at AMR, Siemens Healthineers, TASL's Phase 1 plant, Mahindra Bommasandra (park centroid). LEFT OUT: GE (one unlabelled 'GE' OSM node in Phase 1, entity unknown); Merck, Bosch and TCS nodes in the '360 Business Park' cluster on Neeladri Road (unverified and possibly stale); Trelleborg, D-Link, Medi Assist, Amphenol, Atotech, Opto Circuits, ITI Spacenet (OSM-only, not notable enough to carry at low confidence); Mphasis and LTIMindtree (no Electronics City office could be found on their pages); Honeywell and Indegene (their Bengaluru sites are Bannerghatta Road and Manyata, other lenses); ISRO ISTRAC (Peenya, other lens; Byalalu is outside the metro box); Narayana Health (hospital, excluded as instructed); Infosys BPM as a separate office (its Electronics City plot could not be confirmed, folded into Infosys); Ultraviolette's Electronics City factory (not on its pages; only the Domlur HQ is recorded); Hosur IT Park and the Titan Hosur plant (Tamil Nadu, outside the box); Page Industries and Shahi Exports' Bommasandra/Bommanahalli garment plants (unverified). GEOMETRY: Electronics City Phase 1 and Phase 2 centroids and bboxes are derived from the OSM feature clusters, not an official boundary (Nominatim returned a hotel and a flyover for the phase names); offices without an OSM POI use the park centroid and say so in geocodeSource. Headcounts per site were not stated by any source read, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout. Timken's registered office is given in filings as Electronic City Phase II while OSM places its campus west of Hosur Road; the OSM point is used and the discrepancy noted in the evidence.
